name: prompt
label: Prompt
help: The question to ask, at most 4,000 characters. Pricing: https://serpkite.com/pricing. Failed, refused and empty answers are not billed.

name: country
label: Country
help: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), such as us, gb or de. The API uses us when this is empty.

name: language
label: Language
help: Interface language code, such as en, de or pt-br. The API uses en when this is empty.

name: track
label: Track
help: Up to 20 brands or domains (such as Pipedrive or hubspot.com). Mentions then says whether the answer names each one and whether a cited source is on it.
